detail.lead: Custom printed PVC mesh banners for construction-site fencing, site hoardings and large building-facade graphics. The perforated mesh lets wind pass through, so large graphics carry far less wind load; the trade-off is a semi-transparent image, which makes mesh the wrong choice where a fully opaque graphic is required.
highlights: Perforated mesh reduces wind load on large-format graphics
Made to the dimensions of your project
Hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets available
Suited to fencing, hoardings and facade-scale graphics
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished mesh banners and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Rolled packing; banners are trimmed to the finished size before rolling
detail.artwork: Print-ready artwork can be supplied by the buyer. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive artwork changes or original design work are quoted separately.
detail.brief: Please share finished dimensions, quantity, artwork, installation method, finishing details, delivery format and destination.
detail.caveat: Mesh graphics are perforated and semi-transparent, and are not suitable where a fully opaque image is required. Fence height, fixing method and local wind conditions all affect suitability, so please confirm the installation environment when ordering. Dimensions and pricing are confirmed per order; no list prices are published.
